facts: The paper deals with a recently developed large Czech MWE database.
The Czech MWE database contains at the moment 160 000 MWEs.
The MWEs are treated as lexical units.
The database was compiled from various resources.
The database was compiled from collocations obtained from Czech WordNet.
The authors describe the structure of the database.
The authors give basic types of MWEs according to domains they belong to.
The authors compare the built MWEs database with the corpus data from Czech National Corpus.
These MWEs have not been obtained from the corpus.
The frequencies of the MWEs in the corpus are rather low.
The authors propose and use a technique exploiting the Word Sketch Engine to obtain a more complete list of MWEs.
The technique allows the authors to work with statistical parameters such as frequency of MWEs and their components.
The authors discuss exploitation of the database for working out a more adequate tagging and lemmatization.
The final goal is to be able to recognize MWEs in corpus text.
The final goal is to lemmatize MWEs as complete lexical units.
